title: fix(objectql, rest, service-automation): a mapping name two packages hold is refused naming both at /meta, the import door and the connector pull (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB15UT19uwZoigv8upT552L7)_ Part of #32071 Clause-②: no (narrowing) Narrowing: two, each with first-party count 0. (1) The sealed clash, ruled on #31677 (Q1 letter A, 6729831159): a mapping name two packages held from before phase 1 (the cold-boot seal's warn list) is refused naming both at bare `/meta`, the import door and the pull, instead of answering with the first registered holder. (2) The exact qualifier (ADR-0150 D5, G1's precedent #31959/#32001): `?package=X`, `/meta/mapping/NS/NAME` and `/meta/mapping/_env/NAME` naming a non-holder go from `200` with the holder's mapping to `409` naming the holder. D3 (a) and D3 (c): none, because no reader in this PR has a package caller (the import door and the pull both read with no package), so neither the environment-only nor the outside-closure sub-case is reachable. First-party count for both: 0 (no example app or first-party package declares a mapping name another package declares, or addresses a mapping at a package that does not hold it). Metadata-protocol: none Skills-docs: updated here — `content/docs/data-modeling/import-mappings.mdx` and `content/docs/automation/jobs.mdx` say what a two-holder `mappingName` and `pull` answer; `skills/**` has no `mappingName` or pull-mapping text (`git grep -i mappingName -- skills/` is empty) Claim by `domain:server#3` (6760547602), seat ruling A/A (Claim amendment 6760823385), taken over by `domain:server#3` on `os-support-ai` (6764439957). Reader child for #31700 under epic #31527 (ADR-0150). The card stays open: the pull reading by the job's own package is the card's second half, now that #32078 has landed. ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：`mapping` 加进 objectql 的 `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`（合入 main 后与 #32092 的 `api` 并存）；rest 导入门的 `mappingName` 与 service-automation 的 connector pull 都按「无包调用方」走 ADR-0150 D3，并把 `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` 原样答成它自己的 409（不再吞成 404 `MAPPING_NOT_FOUND`）。 - 为什么改：两个包同名 mapping 时，裸 `/meta`、导入、pull 都静默拿注册顺序第一个；导入另一个包的对象会得到 400 `MAPPING_TARGET_MISMATCH`，pull 会把数据写进别的包的对象。 - 风险与回滚：一个持有者的答案逐字节不变（含跨包导入）。四处答案改为 409（见 BREAKING），第一方受影响 0 处。回滚即 revert。 - 先看：`packages/rest/src/import-mapping.ts` 与 `packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-pull.ts` 的 catch，然后 `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-read.ts` 的一行。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/import-integration.test.ts`，预期 47 条全过。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。pull 按 job 的包读是本卡的第二个 PR。 ## What changes - **`packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-read.ts`**: `mapping` joins `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`, after `api` (#32069, merged from `main`). So G1's exact qualifier (ADR-0150 D5) and the no-package bare read (D3) now apply to `mapping`. A bare read is the environment's own mapping, else the one package that holds the name, else `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` (`409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `ambiguous-in-environment`) naming every holder. - **`packages/rest/src/import-mapping.ts`**: the import door's `mappingName` read (`POST /api/v1/data/:object/import` and the async import job) names no package, so it is a caller with no package under D3. Its `catch {}` used to turn every error into `404 MAPPING_NOT_FOUND`. It now answers a `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` with the error's own `status`, `code` and message, which lists every holder. Every other error keeps today's 404. - **`packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-pull.ts`**: the pull's mapping read is the same no-package read. A refusal now fails the pull before any connector call or write, with the error's own code and status and the new refusal reason `mapping_name_refused`, and the message names every holder. Every other error keeps today's `mapping_not_found` 404. - **Docs**: `content/docs/data-modeling/import-mappings.mdx` (how `mappingName` resolves, the two-holder `409` row in the error table) and `content/docs/automation/jobs.mdx` (which mapping a pull reads, and a refused pull fails the run). - No literal codes or statuses: both readers use the error's own `code`/`status`. The refusal is recognised by class (`instanceof` from `@objectstack/core`) and, as the runtime's `/meta` door's `isPackageScopedRefusal` does, by shape (`code === 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT'` with `refusal.status === 'refused'`), so one that crossed a realm or a second copy of core is still answered as its own `409`. Only a shape with no numeric `status`/`httpStatus` falls back to `409`, as the `/meta` door does. - Not touched: `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES`; the `getItem` fallback for compositions without the slice (#32076); the qualified `mappingName` spelling (#32079); the job's package on the pull (this card's second PR). ### BREAKING (four `mapping` answers, first-party count 0) No example app or first-party package declares a mapping name another package declares, and none addresses a mapping at a package that does not hold it. 1. `GET /api/v1/meta/mapping/NAME` for a name two packages hold: FROM `200` with the first registered holder TO `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both. The fix: `?package=` or `/meta/mapping//NAME`. 2. An import by `mappingName` for such a name: FROM `200` (the request's object was the first holder's target) or `400 MAPPING_TARGET_MISMATCH` (it was the other holder's) TO `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both, with no row written. The fix: rename one of the two mappings; the import door does not yet take a package (#32079). 3. A connector pull of such a name: FROM pulling through the first holder's mapping into its target TO a refused pull, `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, reason `mapping_name_refused`, naming both, before any call or write. The job run records the failure. The fix: as 2, until the card's second PR lets the job's package pick its own. 4. `GET /api/v1/meta/mapping/NAME?package=X`, `/meta/mapping/NS/NAME` and `/meta/mapping/_env/NAME`, where X, NS or the environment does not hold the name: FROM `200` with the holder's mapping TO `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming the holder. This is the same exact-qualifier narrowing G1 (#31959, #32001) made for the E8 types. The fix: address the holder the refusal names. The changeset carries the same FROM → TO and `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, since no stored or authored shape changes, plus a TypeScript note: `ConnectorPullRefusalReason` gains `mapping_name_refused`. ## Why Base readings on main ff04ad81, with `com.qa.bare.alpha` and `com.qa.bare.beta` each holding `qa_shared_mapping` (each targeting its own `*_item`), plus a third package that depends on alpha and holds a mapping into alpha's object: | Door | main | head | |:--|:--|:--| | `GET /meta/mapping/qa_shared_mapping` | 200, alpha's | 409 naming both | | import `qa_shared_mapping` into `alpha_item` | 200 | 409 naming both, no row | | import `qa_shared_mapping` into `beta_item` | 400 `MAPPING_TARGET_MISMATCH` (got alpha's) | 409 naming both, no row | | pull `qa_shared_mapping` | pulls through alpha's | refused 409 naming both | | `/meta/mapping//…`, `?package=` of each holder | 200 | 200, each its own | | one holder, including the cross-package import into alpha's object | 200 | 200, byte-identical | ## Tests - **`packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts`**: a new describe for `mapping`. Two holders are refused on the protocol's bare read (both faces) and the facade's `get`, naming both. Per-package `get` and the `packageId` exact read each reach their holder. CONTROL: one holder answers what `getItem` answers. The environment's item is served, and zero holders is not-found. - **Forced test change**: the same file pins the read set; main's `WIRED_SINCE` (the types wired after E8) now expects `['api', 'picklist', 'mapping']`. - **`packages/rest/src/import-integration.test.ts`**: a new nested describe. Two holders answer `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both and write nothing. A refusal thrown as a plain object of the refusal's shape is answered with its own `409` and sentence. CONTROL: one package holder imports. - **`packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-pull.test.ts`**: a new describe that routes the mapping read through a real `SchemaRegistry` and a real `/meta` protocol. Two holders are refused with the read's own code and 409, reason `mapping_name_refused`, naming both, with no connector call and no write. A plain object of the refusal's shape is refused the same way. CONTROL: one holder pulls. - **Dogfood** `packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder.dogfood.test.ts` (same boot, plus a `zeta` package that depends on alpha and holds a mapping into alpha's object): - Bare `/meta` of the shared name is 409 naming both. - The qualified address and `?package=` each reach their holder. - Importing the shared name into either holder's object is 409 naming both. - A non-holder's qualified read is 409 naming zeta. - CONTROL: showcase's mapping 200 with its `_packageId`; zeta's mapping 200; zeta's import into `alpha_item` 200 with no errors; into `beta_item` still `400 MAPPING_TARGET_MISMATCH`. ## Acceptance notes - The refusal reason name `mapping_name_refused` is new public vocabulary on the pull's refusal union; it is the seat's to confirm. - FROM → TO 4 (a non-holder qualified read) was not on the ruling's list. It falls out of `mapping` joining the read set, the same way G1 did for the E8 types, and it is measured, pinned and declared. - The first main merge resolved one textual conflict, on the read-set line and its pin: every entry is kept (`api` from #32092, then `mapping`). The second (main e0a78783, after #32114) merged clean. The third (after #32097, merge d454dc34) kept the E8 nine, `api`, `picklist` and `mapping`, and kept both the `picklist` and the `mapping` describes in the reader pins and the dogfood file. - #32114 has landed, so the pull request now carries `callerPackageId`; this PR does not read it yet (the comments in `connector-pull.ts` and its test say so). Reading it is the card's second PR. - Relay `pr_create` opened this PR as a draft and dropped assignees. ## Verification ### Landing head a69bdb80 (main after #32097 merged in at d454dc34, no rebase) After a full `turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs` (exit 0), under `os-verify-lock`: - Touched test files: objectql `package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts` 82 passed (the `picklist` describe from main plus this PR's); rest `import-integration.test.ts` 47 passed; service-automation `connector-pull.test.ts` 33 passed. - Typecheck of objectql, rest, service-automation and dogfood: each exit 0. eslint (`--no-inline-config`) on the three merged files: exit 0. - Dogfood `bare-name-one-holder.dogfood.test.ts`: 16 passed (picklist and mapping pins on the one boot). - The only change after 24baf39c besides the merge is one changeset sentence (the pull does not yet read the `callerPackageId` its request carries). ### Head 24baf39c (main e0a78783 merged in at 02300a74, no rebase) Every heavy run went under `os-verify-lock`, after a full `turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs` (exit 0). - Touched test files: objectql `package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts` 77 passed; rest `import-integration.test.ts` 47 passed; service-automation `connector-pull.test.ts` 33 passed. - Ablation of the shape branch (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the shape check replaced by `return undefined`): rest 1 red and service-automation 1 red, exactly the two plain-object pins; restored, `git diff --exit-code HEAD` exit 0. - Typecheck of objectql, rest, service-automation and dogfood: each exit 0. `pnpm lint` (root eslint, `--no-inline-config`): exit 0. - Dogfood `bare-name-one-holder.dogfood.test.ts` alone: 9 passed. The full battery (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, no shard): exit 0, Test Files 446 passed / 3 skipped (449), Tests 3709 passed / 42 skipped (3751), 28m45s. - Gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 100 families on 24baf39c; all 100 exit 0; `--ran` reports 100 derived, 100 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (exit 0). - CI on 24baf39c: 38 success, 15 skipped, 0 failed. ### Head eae53a29 (main 45f0f81f merged in) Same set, all green: touched tests 77 / 46 / 32; four typechecks and `pnpm lint` exit 0; dogfood file 9 passed; full dogfood exit 0 (446 passed / 3 skipped files, 3709 / 42 tests); 100 derived gates all exit 0. ### Earlier head 2dab26ba, branched from main ff04ad81 - `@objectstack/objectql`: 583 files, 12025 passed. `@objectstack/rest`: 399 files, 7660 passed (332 skipped). `@objectstack/service-automation`: 270 files, 3563 passed. Typechecks of objectql, rest, service-automation and dogfood exit 0. eslint (`--no-inline-config`) on the changed files exits 0. - Dogfood, the full battery: 449 files (445 passed, 3 skipped, 1 failed), 3742 tests (3699 passed, 42 skipped, 1 failed). The one failure was a 5000ms timeout in `package-commit-revert-path-package.dogfood.test.ts`, which reads no mapping; rerun alone it passed 12/12. It did not recur on the merged head. - Gates: 74 derived families, all exit 0. - CONTROL byte-identity: the one-holder lines of the base probe and the head probe (11 lines, first 300 bytes of each body, record ids stripped) are identical.
Ablations at 2dab26ba (each restored, git diff HEAD empty, dist rebuilt before dogfood, preflight checked) All used `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; dogfood legs used `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`. 1. Remove `mapping` from `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`: objectql 2 red (the read-set pin, the two-holder refusal), rest 1 red, service-automation 1 red, dogfood 2 red (bare `/meta`, import). The FROM side of FROM → TO 4 (200 with the holder's mapping) was read under this ablation. 2. The import door swallows the refusal again (`catch {}`): rest 1 red; dogfood's import pin red with `404 MAPPING_NOT_FOUND`. 3. The pull swallows the refusal again: service-automation 1 red (`mapping_not_found` instead of `mapping_name_refused`).
